channel.title: Developer Uche — Blog & Notes
channel.description: Writing on zero-knowledge proofs, cryptography, the EVM, Bitcoin and Ethereum protocol research.

item.title: Rapidly Verifiable XMSS Signatures
item.description: How XMSS and WOTS+ work, and how a counter search at signing time makes hash-based signatures verify up to 1.44× faster on embedded devices.

item.title: PSBT Explained: A Deep Dive into BIP174 and BIP370
item.description: Partially Signed Bitcoin Transactions byte by byte: the roles, every field, what signers must verify, PSBT v2 (BIP370), and Taproot and MuSig2 fields.

item.title: Bitcoin Script for Ethereum Developers
item.description: Bitcoin for EVM engineers: the UTXO model, transactions byte by byte, Script, SegWit, Taproot and five generations of multisig, from P2SH to MuSig2.

item.title: Exploring Zcash: Encrypted Money from First Principles
item.description: Zcash from first principles: shielded pools, note commitments, nullifiers and zk-SNARKs, with a transparent and a shielded transaction walked end to end.

item.title: Evolutionary Algorithms: Genetic Algorithms Explained
item.description: Genetic algorithms from first principles: encoding a function as a binary chromosome, the selection-crossover-mutation loop, and tuning it to converge.

item.title: Linear Regression Explained: Loss and Gradient Descent
item.description: Linear regression explained: the model equation, L1 vs L2 loss and MAE/MSE/RMSE, gradient descent, and the learning rate, batch size and epoch tradeoffs.

item.title: Intelligence from First Principles
item.description: A dense reference: the conditions under which the concept is defined, the single mechanism by which it is acquired, and how a unit of it is measured.

item.title: The Sum-Check Protocol Explained (with Rust)
item.description: The sum-check protocol from first principles: proving a polynomial's sum over the Boolean hypercube round by round, with a Rust prover and verifier.

item.title: The ZeroCheck Polynomial IOP Explained
item.description: The ZeroCheck PIOP: proving a polynomial vanishes on a domain, for univariate polynomials via the vanishing polynomial and multilinear ones via sum-check.

item.title: ZisK zkVM: How It Reaches 1.5 GHz Trace Generation
item.description: How the ZisK zkVM reaches 1.5 GHz trace generation: fast emulation, minimal traces and parallel witness generation, and what it means for real-time proving.

item.title: Ethereum Protocol Fellowship Dev Log: zkVM Performance
item.description: My Ethereum Protocol Fellowship project summary: zkVM performance and precompile benchmarks, AOT compilation and stateless block validation.

item.title: Hybrid Ethereum: A RISC-V Execution Engine Experiment
item.description: An experiment replacing Ethereum's EVM sandbox with a RISC-V execution engine: the design, new node components and backward compatibility with the EVM.

item.title: EIP-4337 Account Abstraction Wallets: A Deep Dive
item.description: How EIP-4337 account abstraction separates keys from accounts: bundlers, the entry point contract, paymasters and the user operation lifecycle.

item.title: ZK-Rollups After EIP-4844: From Calldata to Blobs
item.description: How ZK-rollups post data after EIP-4844 (proto-danksharding): blob transactions, KZG commitments, the point evaluation precompile, and cheaper data.

item.title: EIP-7928 Block-Level Access Lists Explained
item.description: EIP-7928 block-level access lists: how recording every state access and diff per block enables parallel disk I/O, parallel EVM execution and ZK proving.

item.title: Chronicle: A Blazing-Fast Blockchain Indexer in Rust
item.description: An introduction to building a blockchain indexer in Rust with Chronicle: parsing transactions, smart contract events and parachain events at speed.

item.title: Building an EIP-2771 Gasless Relayer
item.description: Designing a scalable, fault-tolerant EIP-2771 relayer for gasless meta-transactions: system goals, high-level architecture, security and future work.

item.title: EVM Object Format (EOF) Explained: A Deep Dive
item.description: What the EVM Object Format (EOF) changes for Ethereum smart contracts: the container format, code and data sections, and deploy-time validation.

item.title: What Does the EVM JUMPDEST Opcode Do?
item.description: The EVM JUMPDEST opcode (0x5b) explained: how it marks valid targets for JUMP and JUMPI, how jump destination analysis works, and why it matters.

item.title: How Blockchains Read and Write State in WASM and RISC-V
item.description: State reads and writes aren't native WASM or RISC-V instructions. How blockchain VMs expose storage to contracts through host functions and syscalls.

item.title: Building Blocks of Modern Zero-Knowledge Proofs
item.description: An engineer's guide to the core protocols behind modern zero-knowledge proofs: the sum-check, zero-check, product-check and permutation-check IOPs.

item.title: KZG Polynomial Commitments via Airdrops (Part 1)
item.description: Part 1: how token airdrops work today with Merkle proofs, using Optimism's airdrop, as the starting point for replacing them with KZG commitments.

item.title: KZG Polynomial Commitments via Airdrops (Part 2)
item.description: Part 2: implementing an airdrop with KZG polynomial commitments: committing to the claims, generating proofs, and verifying them in a smart contract.

item.title: Winternitz One-Time Signatures (WOTS) Explained
item.description: How the Winternitz one-time signature (WOTS) scheme works: hash chains, key generation, signing and verification, with a full Rust implementation.

item.title: The Groth16 zk-SNARK Protocol Explained
item.description: A walkthrough of the Groth16 zk-SNARK: bilinear pairings, QAPs, the powers of tau trusted setup, and how the prover and verifier work.

item.title: From R1CS to QAP: Arithmetic Circuits for SNARKs
item.description: How an arithmetic circuit becomes a rank-1 constraint system (R1CS) and then a quadratic arithmetic program (QAP), worked through on a small example.

item.title: The Permutation Check Polynomial IOP (PLONK)
item.description: The permutation check PIOP through the lens of PLONK: proving one vector is a permutation of another with a grand product argument.

item.title: The ProductCheck Polynomial IOP Explained
item.description: The ProductCheck PIOP for univariate and multilinear polynomials: proving a product relation over a domain via ZeroCheck and a random linear combination.

item.title: The Multiset Check IOP in Zero-Knowledge Proofs
item.description: The multiset check IOP: proving two multisets are equal by encoding them as polynomials and testing at a random challenge, and its role in PLONK.

item.title: Merkle Patricia Trie Explained (with Rust)
item.description: How Ethereum's Merkle Patricia Trie works: leaf, extension and branch nodes, nibble paths and hashing, with a Rust implementation.

item.title: Merkle Trees and the Blockchain
item.description: What a Merkle tree is and why blockchains depend on it: hashing transactions into a single root, Merkle proofs, and efficient verification.

item.title: Building a Kademlia Distributed Hash Table (DHT)
item.description: How the Kademlia DHT works and how to build one: XOR distance, k-buckets, node lookups and storing key-value pairs in a peer-to-peer network.

item.title: Fields and Extension Fields in Cryptography
item.description: Lecture notes on finite fields and extension fields for cryptography: prime fields, GF(p^n) built from irreducible polynomials, and field arithmetic.

item.title: The Matryoshka Algorithm for Fast MLE Evaluation
item.description: The Matryoshka algorithm for computing the multilinear extension of a Boolean function efficiently, as used in GKR-style succinct proof systems.

item.title: Jagged (Stacked) Multilinear Extensions for zkVMs
item.description: Jagged multilinear extensions: committing to many tables of different heights as one stacked MLE so zkVM provers avoid wasteful padding.

item.title: Ron Rothblum's Optimization for MLE Evaluation
item.description: Faster multilinear extension evaluation: Ron Rothblum's optimization over naive direct evaluation, and the cost analysis behind it.

item.title: Multilinear Extensions and Direct Evaluation
item.description: Multilinear polynomial extensions explained: interpolating a function over the Boolean hypercube and evaluating the MLE directly with the eq polynomial.
